title: Immediate access revocation (went_invalid with status canceled / valid:false) still leaves access until the old period end
persona: Member whose membership was canceled or expired (cookie + signed Whop webhooks, QA-PAYWALL)
steps: GET /api/slate?sport=nba with cookie -> 200; /account says 'Canceled · access until Nov 26, 2026'.
expected: Whop's 'went_invalid' means the membership is no longer valid (e.g. refund / chargeback / immediate cancel). Guess: access should end then, not days later. At minimum the product rule 'canceled keeps access until period end' only applies to cancel-at-period-end.
actual: Access continues until the stored period end (5 days here). With a refund/chargeback event the member keeps paid data for free.
evidence: Observed twice (qa_can_6 on old build, qa_can_26 on rebuilt build): '200 {status:canceled}' then API 200.
suspected_area: app/src/lib/membership.ts statusFromWebhook: went_invalid with data.status==='canceled' maps to canceled instead of expired; ignores data.valid===false. (Guess: product decision; flagging because refunds are involved.)
